_why: Mutant ids declared BEHAVIOUR-PRESERVING for interp2d, each with the measurement or the proof behind it. `vit_mutate.py --equivalences` reads the KEYS of this object, so the claim and its reason live in one file, and a declared mutant LEAVES THE DENOMINATOR -- every entry is a claim somebody has to be able to answer. The FIRST scoring run of this unit declared NOTHING and scored 0.8072 with 32 survivors, and that run is committed beside this file as mutation/interp2d.first-run-nothing-declared.json, so what survived is on the record before any of it was excused. SIX are declared here. NONE of them is reached by widening the corpus, and that distinction is the point: 17 of the 32 ARE reached by widening it, and they were killed by one judgement in harness/ranges.toml (`nondecreasing_only`) rather than by seventeen more entries in this file. Read evidence/interp2d/mutation.census.txt for the partition of what is left.
98531180: compare_op '<' -> '<=' at `} else if (xq < xData[j - 1]) {`, the x-direction corner search. PROVED FROM THE LINE ABOVE IT, not from the input set. The immediately preceding arm of the same if/else chain is `if (xq == xData[j - 1]) { ... return ...; }`, so control reaches this test only when `xq != xData[j-1]`, and `<` and `<=` differ on exactly one input -- equality -- which this arm cannot see. The reference has the same shape (`IF (xq == xData(j)) ... ELSEIF (xq < xData(j))`), so this is a property of the transcription rather than of the translation. NaN does not open a gap: `xq` NaN returns at the function's first test, `xData(j)` NaN makes both spellings false. NOT REMOVED: the arm is the reference's, statement for statement.
143857a4: compare_op '<' -> '<=' at `} else if (yq < yData[i - 1]) {`, the y-direction corner search. The y half of 98531180, same proof one dimension over: the preceding arm is `if (yq == yData[i - 1]) { ... return ...; }`. The NaN half of that argument became true only at this dispatch -- until 7639168f this translation had no `std::isnan(yq)` guard, so a NaN `yq` DID reach this test and both spellings were false there anyway. The guard is now in (evidence/interp2d/yq-nan-guard.MISTRANSLATION.md), and a NaN `yq` returns before the loop.
7986e5f9: compare_op '<' -> '<=' at `if (x < xData_min) xData_min = x;`, the MINVAL reduction. THE SAME MUTANT, ON THE SAME FOUR LINES, AS interp1d's 20f2a843, and the proof transfers because both halves of it transfer. (i) The loop is byte-identical to interp1d's: seed DBL_MAX, `for (I = 1; I <= n; ++I)`, `if (x < min) min = x`. (ii) The consumer is the same predicate: interp2d reads `xData_min` at exactly one site, `if (xq <= xData_min || std::isnan(xq))`, and the added disjunct does not read it. Loosening the comparison DOES change the stored bits -- 1,666 of 69,905 swept tuples differ, because `-0.0 <= 0.0` is true where `-0.0 < 0.0` is false -- and it cannot change the CONSUMER, because IEEE says `+0.0 == -0.0`. evidence/interp1d/equivalence_probe.cpp sweeps every ordered tuple of length 0..4 over a 16-value set (both zeros, duplicates, both infinities, a NaN, DBL_MAX/MIN and their negatives) crossed with every query in the same set and reports 0 pairs whose consumer differs; re-run for THIS unit's four reductions and this unit's two consumers in evidence/interp2d/equivalence_probe.cpp / .txt. NOT REMOVED: the loop is gfortran's own MINVAL shape and `*std::min_element` disagrees with it under a NaN and on a zero-size array.
1235716b: compare_op '>' -> '>=' at `if (x > xData_max) xData_max = x;`. The MAXVAL half of 7986e5f9, same probe, same run, same 0. Consumer is `} else if (xq >= xData_max) {`, the one site that reads it.
b9162232: compare_op '<' -> '<=' at `if (y < yData_min) yData_min = y;`. The y-direction MINVAL, same code and same argument as 7986e5f9. Consumer is `if (yq <= yData_min || std::isnan(yq))`. The four reductions are swept TOGETHER in one probe rather than separately, because a tie in one and a tie in another can occur in the same table and the question is whether the pair of consumers can see it.
acb38635: compare_op '>' -> '>=' at `if (y > yData_max) yData_max = y;`. The y-direction MAXVAL. Consumer is `} else if (yq >= yData_max) {`.
